Candidate or superseded memories should not displace active lessons, old brand residue should not leak, and the 1M baseline should prove deterministic runtime consumption coverage before stronger rollout.
actualTranscript: Final verification passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; lattice validate --story=B-4eea --json with 31 configured commands; lattice done_required_validate ran build plus root npm test; playbook-runtime-memory-mvp1-smoke, mvp2-smoke, health-smoke, baseline-smoke, baseline-smoke --profile=full, command-catalog-smoke, process-fact contract, runtime-fact contract, and residue guard all passed. Full baseline generated and verified exactly 1,000,000 records after F-014 and residue cleanup. 3 rounds x 2 hosts were submitted with claude-cli and codex-cli only; agy-cli was not counted.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for the planned M5-M12 scope. The only retained boundary is intentional: runtime memory is not proof and cannot satisfy DONE; performance targets for the 1M baseline remain report-first rather than hard fail.
limitations: Memory packs are non-authoritative advisory context and have gateEvidence=false. Performance is reported first and not yet an enforce-mode threshold. Authority-style production claims are not used. agy-cli is fallback only when codex-cli or claude-cli is unavailable, quota-limited, or explicitly needed as standby.
pitfalls: Claude CLI must remain the primary peer with Codex CLI for default 3x2 host verification; agy-cli is only fallback. Do not treat dev-memory or playbook packs as DONE evidence. Re-run baseline full profile before enforce rollout, and regenerate review/delivery/DONE evidence whenever materialHash or storyFilesHash changes.
